name: Puffco | Peak Pro 3DXL | Onyx
description:
The new Peak Pro is the pinnacle of hash technology. This premium smart rig delivers incredible flavor and unparalleled performance. Unlock the fullest potential of the plant with its single-button interface, deep customization via the Puffco Connect app, and patented 3D XL Chamber. Featuring the Joystick Cap and laser cut perc slots for improved water filtration, enjoy the best hash experience ever in two beautiful colorways – Onyx and Pearl.

The future of hash is here.
